transcript: Speaker A: This is Espresso. Espresso is strong black coffee. It is small but very strong. This is an Americano. Americano is espresso with hot water. It is smoother and lighter. This is Cappuccino. Cappuccino has milk foam. It is creamy and soft. This is a Latte. Latte has more milk. It tastes smooth. This is Mocha. Mocha is coffee with chocolate. It tastes sweet. This is Macchiato. Macchiato is espresso with a little milk. It is strong.
